title: Lorenzo Tio as the greatest clarinetist
summary: Laurent says no clarinetist could be greater than Lorenzo, who excelled at jazz, opera and brass band, playing E flat on parade.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Yeah. Can you tell me who was your favorite clarinet player of all that you heard any place or any time? Who would, if you had to listen to just one clarinet player once more who would you want to hear?

Well I'm going to tell you at the time, at my time when I was talking about, I don't think it would come any greater than that boy Lorenzo. I don't think it would come any greater. I don't think it could come
any greater. Was he good for jazz and everything? Oh I'm telling you, jazz, opera, brass band,
and he played all them funeral drums. He was with the two largest brass band you had here.
Do you remember did he play an E flat or B flat on the parade? E flat. E flat, the little one.
